summary.text: Channing Taylor is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 127 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Mark Newton.
A U.S. Army veteran who served from 2005 to 2022 and works as a musician, he describes himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a retired Army captain and activist.

paragraphs.text: Channing Taylor graduated from Jordan Vocational High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Columbus State University in 2012.
He served in the U.S. Army from 2005 to 2022, and his career experience includes working as a musician.
Taylor advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is also known as Von-T and that he began the "Americans Make America Great" movement, which he described as a movement against greed.
